title: Air Fryer Gochujang Chicken
description: Sticky, spicy-sweet. Sauce made in the Thermomix, char and glaze finished in the air fryer.

steps.text: Add the gochujang ({{gochujang}}), soy ({{soy}}), honey ({{honey}}), sesame oil ({{sesame-oil}}), garlic ({{garlic}} cloves), ginger ({{ginger}}) and vinegar ({{vinegar}}) to the bowl. Blitz 10 sec / Speed 4 until smooth. Set aside half for glazing.
Coat the chicken ({{chicken}}) in the remaining half. Let it sit at least 10 minutes if you have time.
Air fry at 190°C for 6 minutes. Flip, brush with the reserved sauce, and cook a further 6–8 minutes until caramelised at the edges.
Check the thickest part reads 74°C. If it is not quite there, give it another 2–3 minutes rather than guessing by time.
Rest 5 minutes, then slice. Scatter with sesame seeds ({{sesame-seeds}}) and spring onion ({{spring-onion}}).

notes.title: No Thermomix
notes.text: Whisk the sauce by hand. Mince the garlic finely and grate the ginger so they blend smoothly. A splash of water loosens lumpy gochujang.

notes.title: Salt
notes.text: None added. Soy and gochujang carry plenty.

notes.title: To serve
notes.text: Over rice with the Korean cucumber salad on the side, or shredded into lettuce cups.
